people.name: Olives_Mount
people.line: A mountain ridge east of Jerusalem

translations.web: He came out and went, as his custom was, to the Mount of Olives. His disciples also followed him.
translations.bsb: Jesus went out as usual to the Mount of Olives, and the disciples followed Him.
translations.kjv: And he came out, and went, as he was wont, to the mount of Olives; and his disciples also followed him.
translations.asv: And he came out, and went, as his custom was, unto the mount of Olives; and the disciples also followed him.
